name: 15111-eagle3largepage-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the target, with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B as the EAGLE3 draft head. The target is an ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- same weights; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- one GPU, unsharded.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, float16. Draft: LlamaForCausalLMEagle3, one decoder layer, float16, max_position_embeddings 2048.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 200 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure, seed 42. Prompts 512 +- 64 tokens clamped to [256, 768], generations a fixed 1024 tokens; the clamps keep the worst-case request at 1792 tokens, inside the 2048 positions the draft head declares. `temperature: 0` and `ignore_eos: true` are both set, so the token stream is deterministic and every request generates its full length.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on one GPU, drafting 1024-token replies for a single user with speculative decoding.
launch:
# sglang launch arguments: one H100 serving Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with EAGLE3 tree drafting over
# a large-page KV cache.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# float16, not the checkpoint's native bfloat16: the EAGLE3 head below is a float16 checkpoint.
dtype: float16

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE3
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 8
speculative-eagle-topk: 5
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 64
page-size: 256

# REQUIRED, not preferred: this version refuses to start with speculative topk > 1 and page size
# > 1 on any backend outside {flashinfer, fa3}.
attention-backend: fa3

# No context-length key: the server runs the target's own context window, and the draft model is
# given that same length. The draft head declares max_position_embeddings 2048, so sglang refuses
# the longer length unless SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN=1, which is an environment
# variable with no server argument and is therefore set in tuned.yaml.

# Declared rather than auto-selected: the engine asserts chunked_prefill_size % page_size == 0.
chunked-prefill-size: 8192

# Declared rather than auto-selected: the engine would otherwise reset this to 48 on its own for
# speculative decoding.
max-running-requests: 4

mem-fraction-static: 0.7

# The first decode batch at speculative topk 5 over 256-token pages JIT-compiles the draft-tree KV
# copy kernel, which can take longer than the default 300 s scheduler watchdog; the watchdog then
# kills the server mid-compile. It is a liveness guard, not a serving setting.
watchdog-timeout: 1800
disable-radix-cache: true
random-seed: 42
